title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode5 BAD DOGS

rows.Line: Live House
You performed really well, today. Thanks, guys.
Thank you for tonight.

rows.Speaker: New Staff
rows.Line: Man, BAD DOGS sure put on another hardcore show tonight. Their performance actually gave me goosebumps.

rows.Speaker: Experienced Staff
rows.Line: Yeah, they're the real deal. Do this long enough and you develop an eye for diamonds in the rough. Those two have stood out since day one, though. So much that it's not even funny.

rows.Speaker: New Staff
rows.Line: I can tell a lot of the customers come just to see them. For high schoolers, they've really got it together.
Toya, I'm going to change the set list a bit for next month's events.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So you were thinking the same thing? A lot of our audience has heard us play a few times now. It'd probably be better to add a few of our more polished songs.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Hey, Akito! Toya! Great set tonight. You two have been putting on shows every week lately. Really giving it your all, I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Naturally. When Ken was our age, shows like this were child's play to him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If we're going to surpass his RAD WEEKEND event, we're going to need all the experience we can get.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Haha. You've been saying that forever. The idea of anyone putting on a show better than that is crazy, though.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It ain't crazy. And even if it were, it doesn't matter. We already decided that's what we're gonna do.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
Hey now, calm down.
I know as well as anyone how good you guys are.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: But nobody can compare with RAD WEEKEND. Akito, you were there, weren't you? You know what I'm talking about.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: That night was something else entirely. Ken, his crew, the audience. Everything was perfect. Tonight's show doesn't even come close.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Tsk. I'm well aware of that.
Why do you think we're working so hard?

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: That reminds me. Ken's daughter is always saying she's going to surpass RAD WEEKEND as well. Maybe you guys should try teaming up?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: An Shiraishi, huh? She isn't bad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'd be more than happy to team up with her.
So long as she's got the talent... and drive.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: T-Team up? As in, you and me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! You felt how great it was to sing together just now, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well, I-I suppose so, but...I-I don't think someone like me is really good enough to team up with someone like you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, don't ever put yourself down, alright?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've been going to events and listening to people sing ever since I was little. I've heard a lot of really talented people.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But singing with you today was the most exhilarated I've ever felt! I want to try singing more songs with you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You felt exhilarated...listening to me sing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I get really nervous when I'm in front of people.
I feel like I'd just be an inconvenience to you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I wonder if I could change, though...
Is it really okay for me to try?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And you're welcome to be as much of an inconvenience as you like.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A team is supposed to cooperate and support each other. I'll make sure to help you when you need it as long as you promise to do the same for me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My dad had a team like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They were other musicians he met here in town. He says they always had each other's backs, getting into fights and singing together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just before my dad retired, they put on an event called RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. This area has always had a lot of artists, and they put on events all the time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But my dad and his team organized this event called RAD WEEKEND and gathered a bunch of the best ones who really knew how to get a crowd going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was a mix of all sorts of genres, but everyone shared an absolute love of music.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was the coolest event ever! It was so exciting I could barely breathe. I thought my heart was going to explode!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sounds exciting...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I told my dad that I wanted to organize an event just like his. I still remember his response.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He said, "This event was only possible because of all the people I'd met in this town who love music so much. There's no way I could have done this on my own."

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It made me want to start meeting those kinds of people. My dream is to organize the greatest event in history with them!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An is so cool. She's already found a dream and is working hard to make it happen.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She's so different from me...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha. Sorry, I got a little carried away there. Don't feel like you have to answer right away, but if you'd like to give it a shot, just let me—

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to try.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I want to try doing an event like that.
I want to try teaming up with you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? You'll sing with me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm, uh, not sure how much I can actually do, but I'll try my best!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Great! Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What should I do... I know I said I'd do it, but I'm still a little afraid...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Still...the idea of actually getting to sing with An is kind of exciting!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, looks like we've got a customer. I'll be right back. Welco—oh hey, Akito, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey there, Shiraishi.
Thought we'd stop in again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Welcome! Thanks for always coming by.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We'll have the usual. Hm?
I don't think I've seen you around before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Th-They seem a little scary... But if they're friends of An's, they can't be that bad, right?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
The name's Akito Shinonome. Nice to meet you.
This here's my buddy, Toya Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-It's very nice to meet you. My name is Kohane Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...No need to be so formal.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: These two are freshmen with me at Kamiyama High School. They're also big fans of my dad's.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They call themselves BAD DOGS. They're in the area a lot doing shows, so they like to stop by before they start or after they're done.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We've known Shiraishi and have been coming here since junior high.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Junior high? You mean you've been putting on shows since you were in junior high school? That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hahaha. Just playing in shows isn't a big deal.
Anybody can do it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Speaking of, you managed to find a someone to sing with yet, Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you're really serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND, don't you think it's about time you teamed up with someone?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You've got great timing. As a matter of fact, I found someone just a few minutes ago!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A few minutes ago?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you talking about her?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right! Kohane is my new partner! I knew as soon as we sang together today!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Coming from you, that must mean she's quite the singer. Where have you performed before, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, I-I, uh... I've never actually performed before. I've only ever really sang during music class.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No experience performing and you can still sing that well? That's amazing, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll get used to singing in front of people in no time. Once you do, I bet you'll be even better than Akito and Toya!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In that case, I've got an idea. How would you two like to be part of an upcoming event?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?!
